snippet.title: Civilization VI: Platinum Edition | Official Game Trailer | Netflix
snippet.description:
Build sprawling cities, invest in cultural progress and forge alliances — or wage war. The world is yours to lead in this classic strategy game.

Play Civilization VI on your mobile devices. Available exclusively on Netflix: https://www.netflix.com/game/81768969

About Netflix:
Netflix is one of the world's leading entertainment services, with 283 million paid memberships in over 190 countries enjoying TV series, films and games across a wide variety of genres and languages. Members can play, pause and resume watching as much as they want, anytime, anywhere, and can change their plans at any time.
